01003.name: Baldwin County
a: Gulf Shores Department of Fire & Emergency Services
Lifeguard Ambulance Service LLC D / B / A Medstar EMS

01009.name: Blount County
01009.note: Unverified lead, not yet independently checked. AmeriPro EMS was selected in November 2025 as Blount County's new 911 ambulance provider, replacing the previous contractor. Not yet confirmed: the start date, and whether Blountsville Fire and Rescue and the city of Oneonta run their own ambulances.

01011.name: Bullock County
01011.note: Unverified lead, not yet independently checked. Haynes Ambulance runs an ambulance station in Union Springs and is the only ground ambulance service licensed in Bullock County. A page naming it as the county's 911 ambulance provider has not been found yet.

01019.name: Cherokee County
01019.note: Unverified lead, not yet independently checked. Atrium Health Floyd is the 911 ambulance provider for Cherokee County. Not yet confirmed: whether Piedmont Rescue & EMS also carries patients from the Cherokee County part of Piedmont.

01021.name: Chilton County
01021.via: Alabama Department of Public Health licensee list and agency websites (local sources)
01021.note: Regional Paramedical Services (RPS) is the county's contracted ambulance service, with three ambulances dedicated to Chilton County since November 2025. Clanton Fire Department also runs its own ambulances inside the city of Clanton. In September 2026 the county formed a new authority (CCare) to add response units alongside RPS; it was not yet running transports when reported.

01029.name: Cleburne County
01029.note: Unverified lead, not yet independently checked. Cleburne County EMS is the only ground ambulance service licensed in Cleburne County. A current page describing its 911 role has not been found yet, and a 2019 report of a Georgia company planning service in Ranburne is unresolved.

01031.name: Coffee County
01031.note: Unverified lead, not yet independently checked. Enterprise Rescue says its ground operations are based in Coffee County and it is the only ground ambulance service licensed there. Not yet confirmed: that it covers all of the county, including Elba and the Fort Novosel area.

01033.name: Colbert County
01033.via: Alabama Department of Public Health licensee list and agency websites (local sources)
01033.note: Keller EMS, run by Helen Keller Hospital, is the ground ambulance service for Colbert County 911. The Muscle Shoals, Sheffield and Tuscumbia fire departments and the volunteer fire departments respond but do not transport.
a: Keller EMS (Helen Keller Hospital, HH Health System)

01035.name: Conecuh County
a: Star of Life Systems Inc Dba Conecuh County EMS

01047.name: Dallas County
01047.note: Unverified lead, not yet independently checked. Dallas County's volunteer rescue squads respond first and wait for an ambulance. The only licensed ground ambulance service based in the county is Jackson Emergency Transport Service, but a page naming it as the 911 ambulance provider has not been found yet.

01049.name: DeKalb County
01049.note: Unverified lead, not yet independently checked. DeKalb Ambulance Service is the only ambulance service based in the county, but a current public page naming it as the county's 911 ambulance provider has not been found yet.

01051.name: Elmore County
a: Haynes Ambulance of Elmore County, LLC

01053.name: Escambia County
a: Lifeguard Ambulance Service, LLC D / B / A Medstar EMS - Escambia

01057.name: Fayette County
a: Northstar EMS Inc. Dba Fayette County EMS

01059.name: Franklin County
a: Hh Health System Emergency Medical Service, LLC, Dba-Keller EMS-Franklin

01063.name: Greene County
01063.via: Alabama Department of Public Health licensee list and agency websites (local sources)
01063.note: Greene County EMS is the county's ambulance service. It stopped transporting for about a week in early July 2026 for lack of a compliant ambulance and has since received two new ambulances.

01071.name: Jackson County
01071.note: Unverified lead, not yet independently checked. Highlands EMS, run by Highlands Medical Center, is the only ground ambulance service based in the county, but a public page naming it as the 911 ambulance provider for the whole county has not been found yet.
a: Hh Health System Emergency Medical Service, LLC, Dba-Highlands EMS

01073.name: Jefferson County
01073.note: Unverified lead, not yet independently checked. About 25 services are licensed to transport in Jefferson County, mostly city and district fire departments plus private ambulance companies. Not yet confirmed from a public source: the county 911 EMS zone plan, so no single provider is shown.

01077.name: Lauderdale County
01077.via: Alabama Department of Public Health licensee list and agency websites (local sources)
01077.note: Lifeguard Ambulance Service, part of AMR, holds the ambulance contract for Lauderdale County and the city of Florence. In 2024 the county and city agreed a three-year contract with it. Florence Fire Department responds to medical calls but does not transport.

01079.name: Lawrence County
01079.via: Alabama Department of Public Health licensee list and agency websites (local sources)
01079.note: Lawrence County EMS (Greg's Ambulance Service) answers 911 calls and transports patients in Lawrence County. A backup Lawrence County EMS ambulance is kept at the Speake fire station.

01081.name: Lee County
01081.note: Unverified lead, not yet independently checked. Seen on a public page: East Alabama EMS (EAMC) and Auburn Fire Department EMS are both licensed to transport. Not yet confirmed from a current public source: which one transports 911 patients in Auburn and Opelika.
a: East Alabama Emergency Medical Services, LLC

01083.name: Limestone County
01083.note: Unverified lead, not yet independently checked. Athens-Limestone Hospital EMS answers 911 calls in Limestone County. Not yet confirmed: who carries patients in the parts of Huntsville and Madison that lie in Limestone County (likely HEMSI).
a: Hh Health System Emergency Medical Service, LLC, Dba-Athens Limestone EMS

01085.name: Lowndes County
01085.via: Alabama Department of Public Health licensee list and agency websites (local sources)
01085.note: Haynes Ambulance runs the ambulance service in Lowndes County, with stations in the county, and transports patients from emergency scenes there. It is the only ambulance service licensed in the county.
a: Haynes Ambulance (Haynes Ambulance of Troy, LLC - Lowndes)

01087.name: Macon County
01087.via: Alabama Department of Public Health licensee list and agency websites (local sources)
01087.note: Haynes Ambulance runs the ambulance service in Macon County, with stations in the county, and transports patients from emergency scenes there. It is the only ambulance service licensed in the county. Local volunteer fire departments respond but do not transport.

01089.name: Madison County
01089.via: Alabama Department of Public Health licensee list and agency websites (local sources)
01089.note: HEMSI is the only transport-licensed service in Madison County. Huntsville Fire & Rescue and other fire departments respond but are not licensed to transport.

01091.name: Marengo County
01091.via: Alabama Department of Public Health licensee list and agency websites (local sources)
01091.note: AmStar EMS, based in Demopolis with stations in Linden and Dixons Mills, provides 911 ambulance service across Marengo County.

01093.name: Marion County
01093.note: Unverified lead, not yet independently checked. Marion County EMS is the only ambulance service based in the county. The county 911 centre says it works with two emergency medical services; the second one is not yet confirmed.

01095.name: Marshall County
01095.note: Unverified lead, not yet independently checked. Marshall Medical EMS runs eight 24-hour ambulances across Marshall County, and Albertville Fire and Rescue bills for its own ambulance calls. Not yet confirmed: how Boaz Fire and Rescue's licensed ambulances share the Boaz area with Marshall Medical EMS.
a: Hh Health System Emergency Medical Service, LLC, Dba-Marshall Medical EMS

01097.name: Mobile County
a: Mobile County Emergency Medical Services Systems, Inc

01101.name: Montgomery County
01101.note: Unverified lead, not yet independently checked. Montgomery Fire/Rescue provides ALS first response (2018 state newsletter). Not yet confirmed from a current public source: which ambulance companies take 911 transports; older news reports describe a two-company rotation.
a: Haynes Ambulance of Macon Co, D / B / A Care Ambulance- Mgm

01103.name: Morgan County
01103.via: Alabama Department of Public Health licensee list and agency websites (local sources)
01103.note: Decatur Morgan EMS, run by Decatur Morgan Hospital, is the ambulance service for all of Morgan County, including the city of Decatur. The city fire departments (Decatur, Hartselle, Falkville) respond to medical calls but do not transport.
a: Decatur Morgan EMS (HH Health System Emergency Medical Service, LLC)

01105.name: Perry County
01105.via: Alabama Department of Public Health licensee list and agency websites (local sources)
01105.note: Perry County runs its own ambulance service, which answers 911 calls across the county, including Marion and Uniontown.
a: Perry County Ambulance Service (PC Ambulance, Inc.)

01107.name: Pickens County
01107.note: Unverified lead, not yet independently checked. NorthStar EMS stopped serving Pickens County in late 2024 or early 2025, and the county now funds two ambulances of its own. Not yet confirmed: a current page naming the service that runs them.

01113.name: Russell County
a: Haynes Ambulance of Macon Co, D / B / A Care Ambulance - Russell

01117.name: Shelby County
a: Cahaba Valley Fire and Emr District

01127.name: Walker County
01127.via: Alabama Department of Public Health licensee list and agency websites (local sources)
01127.note: Regional Paramedical Services (RPS) is the ambulance service that answers 911 calls in Walker County. City fire departments and volunteer rescue squads respond to medical calls but do not transport.

01131.name: Wilcox County
01131.via: Alabama Department of Public Health licensee list and agency websites (local sources)
01131.note: MedCare EMS, operated by J. Paul Jones Rural Emergency Hospital in Camden, is Wilcox County's ambulance service.
